changelog:
Moltbank Skill v0.1.11

- Added Polymarket and Pump.fun trading support via new Moltbank CLI tools.
- Onboarding flow updated: agent creation displays in-Moltbank UI name and enforces agent display name input at pairing.
- Introduced per-agent OAuth scope consent, including explicit surface/handling of consent URLs for tool access.
- Workflow intent tracking and audit chain documentation expanded for multi-step financial actions.
- Description updated to reflect new trading capabilities and clarified per-session credential/user consent protocols.
